scope: real local Console/MinIO and two native macOS arm64 BoxLite Workers, one cross-worker filesystem snapshot with 65536 small files

dataset.ownership: each small file must match the guest execution UID/GID

fingerprint.algorithm: SHA-256(main file bytes || domain || uint64be file_count || uint64be small_file_bytes || ordered records)
fingerprint.record: uint64be index || uint16be mode || 32 content-SHA256 bytes

dataset.persistence_flush: main file and manifest fsync; guest-wide sync after creating all small-file data and directory/link metadata
dataset.memory: main data streams in <=1 MiB blocks; small data in 1 KiB blocks, fixed-width manifest records, <=256-entry directory comparisons

conditions.target_sdk_image_cache: warm; exact reference/index/blob presence and one SDK reuse, zero pull events in restore window
conditions.guest_preflight_bytes: main bytes + small_file_count*max(1024,filesystem fragment size) + manifest record bytes + 32 MiB margin

limits.comparison: one published sequential sample on one host; registry/CDN, OS page cache and unrelated host load uncontrolled. Additional small-file data, inode/directory and link metadata are all part of this dataset; not a fixed-byte single-variable file-count comparison or a production SLO
limits.timing: Worker times are per awaited method, including internal checks/permit waits/retries; API times span POST submission through polled terminal state. Stage sums omit Console/DB/scheduling/activation and inter-call gaps
limits.disk: metadata accounting of SDK homes/journals from before authentication/seed through verification/deletion/cleanup and child exit. Includes existing caches/history; excludes S3/build/other paths. Hard links deduplicated, symlinks not followed; COW/reflink shared blocks may be multiply counted and short peaks/races missed. Sampling overhead not subtracted; not a hard physical peak or quota recommendation
